data.long_meaning: A woman who is given rest or a place of rest, a place of safety or security. The name Rukayat carries the meaning “Rest” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Rukayat usually hope their child will grow to embody rest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes peace, tranquility, and safety. It is believed that the bearer of this name will be granted protection, comfort, and a sense of security in all aspects of her life.
data.etymology: Rukayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukayat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rukayat" signifies the idea of giving a woman a place of refuge and protection. In many Islamic societies, the name can be seen as a symbol of the importance of providing a haven for women, especially in times of hardship or danger. It emphasizes the role of men in shielding and caring for their female counterparts.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Rukayat" can be seen as representing the divine protection and refuge offered by Allah to believers. It is a reminder of the peace and solace that can be found in His presence, and the security that comes from trusting and surrendering to His will. The name can also be interpreted as a call to strive to be a source of comfort and shelter to others, emulating the compassionate and loving nature of Allah.
